criteria.description: Digs past symptoms to root causes on the items that mattered (e.g. WHY on-call ownership was undefined, WHY Sales wasn't informed of the cuts) rather than just listing what went badly.
Lands a small set of concrete improvement actions, each with an owner, rather than a long unowned wish list or no actions.
Frames problems as system/process issues, not blaming individuals.
Notes what went well (e.g. standups) to keep doing, not only problems.
Separates observations/causes from the actions, rather than jumping straight from a complaint to a pet solution.
